baseline_models.mechanism: The positive pole is active kin-connection and beneficence toward the mother; the negated pole is coercive mastery. Filial good is defined by its non-dominating mode.

activation_trace.role: Connection and beneficence against severance supplies the positive maternal relation.
Parenthood through birth fixes the beneficiary specifically as his mother.
Coercion and overpowering supplies the explicitly negated relational mode.

changed_reading.before: He is dutiful to his mother and is not a tyrant.
changed_reading.after: His birr is beneficent maternal connection whose defining form is refusal of coercion.

baseline_models.mechanism: State-making makes the negative predicates a denied constitution rather than isolated acts: he is not formed for coercive mastery, arduous struggle, or wretchedness.

activation_trace.role: Causative placement into a state frames character as a conferred life-disposition.
Overpowering supplies the denied posture of mastery.
Hardship and sustained struggle supplies the denied arduous trajectory.
Wretchedness contrary to felicity supplies the denied total condition from the second mapped inventory.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists bad traits he lacks.
changed_reading.after: The verse denies a whole constituted trajectory of coercion, struggle, and wretchedness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The making-chain constitutes him as a public sign, mercy, prophet, and stable good, then refuses to constitute him as coercive. Non-domination is a boundary on mission, with maternal birr as its nearest enactment.

activation_trace.role: Making into a state begins the chain by assigning a public purpose.
A visible sign supplies the public-facing scope of that purpose.
Tender mercy supplies the positive mode in which the sign operates.
The womb branch adds maternal embodiment without replacing the lexical mercy sense.
A second state-making assigns prophetic office.
A third state-making assigns the immediately preceding positive condition.
Stable, growing good supplies the beneficial quality of his presence.
Coercive mastery supplies the mode excluded from sign, mercy, prophecy, and blessing.
Maternal beneficence supplies the first concrete relational enactment of mercy.

structural_cues: جعل recurs at 19:21, 19:30, 19:31, and in negated form at 19:32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: repeated making assigns sign, mercy, prophecy, and blessing before coercive identity is negated. Reader arrow: the negation regulates how the mission may act. Live alternative: these may be adjacent but independent predicates.

changed_reading.before: He is merciful in mission and separately not tyrannical.
changed_reading.after: His mission is constituted to work as mercy, so coercion would contradict it; birr toward his mother is its nearest test.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mother bears pregnancy, labor disturbance, threatened erasure, grief, visible carrying, and sexual stigma. Birr plus non-shaqi can mark an interruption: the child will not become the continuation or distributor of her hardship.

activation_trace.role: The inward pregnancy load supplies the first maternal burden.
The carrier's disturbance in labor supplies acute bodily hardship.
The forgotten, cast-off thing supplies threatened erasure at the ordeal's nadir.
Grief that roughens the self supplies the affective burden explicitly answered.
Visible carrying turns the hidden bodily load into a public social load.
Sexual immorality supplies the explicit stigma directed through maternal lineage.
Beneficent maternal connection supplies the positive interruption of burden.
Hardship and sustained struggle supplies what his life does not perpetuate.
The second mapped inventory independently reinforces the hardship field.

structural_cues: Pregnancy and labor lead through a death-wish to public carrying and accusation before the child's focus declaration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: concentrated maternal bodily and social burden followed by his birr and non-shaqi predicates. Reader arrow: his non-wretched constitution interrupts transmission of that burden back onto her. Live alternative: شقي describes only his own condition.

changed_reading.before: He himself will not be miserable.
changed_reading.after: His non-shaqi life is read relationally: filial good refuses to turn the mother's costly bearing of him into continuing hardship for her.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mary's vowed silence, the accusation, her gesture, and the challenged possibility of speech route the public burden to the infant. His resulting declaration makes filial goodness performative protective testimony.

activation_trace.role: Restraint of the tongue creates the communicative vacancy the child fills.
Meaningful speech connecting interlocutors is explicitly withheld by the mother.
The sexual accusation supplies the public danger to which protective speech responds.
A bodily gesture transfers the communicative turn from mother to child.
Actual utterance begins the answer that carries through the focus ayah.
Truth fixed against falsehood validates the declaration's testimonial function.
Truth carried through word and deed makes the spoken claim an enacted form of birr.
Maternal beneficence identifies whom the truthful speech immediately protects.

structural_cues: Mary vows silence at 19:26, is accused at 19:27-28, points at 19:29, and the child's speech runs through 19:33 before 19:34 names a word of truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: silence, accusation, gesture, infant speech, and a truth formula. Reader arrow: his declaration bears the speech burden for his mother and performs birr. Live alternative: the speech establishes his own identity and shelters her only indirectly.

changed_reading.before: He promises a future disposition of dutifulness.
changed_reading.after: By naming his maternal relation truthfully when she cannot answer, he is already enacting birr as public shelter.

context_deltas.mechanism: He identifies as God's servant, then names one Lord for himself and the audience and directs worship along a straight path. Delegated speech cannot become self-sovereign coercion.

activation_trace.role: Owned servanthood supplies the non-sovereign position from which he speaks.
Shared divine lordship reserves mastery for the Lord of speaker and audience.
Worshipful obedience supplies the alternative to human self-exaltation.
The straight road supplies a shared route rather than a sovereign position.
Uprightness and balance specifies that route's order.
Coercive mastery is incompatible with servanthood under shared lordship.

structural_cues: The speech opens with عبد الله at 19:30 and later grounds speaker and audience under ربي وربكم at 19:36.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: self-identification as servant followed by shared lordship and worship. Reader arrow: vertical servanthood blocks horizontal claims to coercive sovereignty. Live alternative: جبار may remain a personal vice without this authority dimension.

changed_reading.after: Not-jabbar limits religious authority: the servant-messenger may testify and guide but may not occupy coercive lordship.

context_deltas.mechanism: Peace spans birth, death, and renewed life immediately after the focus; later comes a day of regret when the matter is complete. Non-shaqi expands from present mood into a whole temporal trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Hardship and struggle supplies the arduous trajectory denied by the focus.
Wretchedness contrary to felicity supplies the denied total condition.
Safety and freedom from harm supplies the positive condition spanning the thresholds.
Birth fixes the first threshold and recalls the maternal anchor.
Loss of life fixes the second threshold under peace.
Rousing the still supplies the third threshold and completes the arc.
Regret over what is lost supplies the contrasting end-state.
Completion closes the alternative trajectory when regret can no longer repair it.

structural_cues: The focus is followed by three يوم clauses under السلام; 19:39 names the day of regret after the matter is finished.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: peace brackets three life thresholds, followed later by finalized regret. Reader arrow: these temporal frames enlarge non-shaqi into a protected life-course. Live alternative: the peace formula and warning may be adjacent rather than interpretively linked.

changed_reading.after: He is not constituted for a wretched arc: maternal birth, death, and renewed life are under peace rather than terminal regret.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because جبار most directly activates coercion here, while the same root's fracture-repair branch is form-distant. It remains anchored by the explicit ج ب ر fork, maternal birr, and contextual support and speech. Render only as exploratory root-play about the mode of repair, never as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: Beneficent reconnection supplies a reparative maternal relation.
Mending fracture or lack supplies the repair image latent in the root.
Coercive forcing supplies the danger into which repair must not turn.
The palm trunk supplies concrete support beside the laboring mother.
Speech connecting interlocutors supplies a social means of repair.

changed_reading.before: He is simply not an oppressor.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he also refuses coercive fixing: maternal rupture is mended by connection, support, and speech rather than overpowering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the syntax strongly selects relational birr, not literal dry land. It remains anchored by the packet's ب ر ر dry-land branch and the adjacent labor, flow, and moisture sequence. Render only as a material analogy of stabilizing ground around maternal vulnerability while preserving beneficence as the lexical reading.

activation_trace.role: Dry land against sea supplies the exploratory image of stable ground.
Agitated liquid in its vessel supplies material turbulence within the labor term.
The flowing current activates the water-side contrast with dry ground.
Moisture and softness against dryness sharpens the material polarity.

changed_reading.before: Birr denotes only an ethical disposition toward the mother.
changed_reading.after: Without changing that lexical sense, birr also carries an exploratory image of dependable ground amid maternal labor's turbulence.

strongest_changes: Birr became public protective speech, not merely later private obedience.
The making-chain turned noncoercion into a boundary on a mission of sign, mercy, prophecy, and blessing.
Maternal burden made non-shaqi legible as an interruption of transmitted hardship.
Servanthood and the peace-framed life arc widened the negations from temperament into authority and trajectory.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sits where maternal silence and accusation become the child's speech; branch interplay joined kin-connection, mercy and womb, making, coercion and repair, and hardship without collapsing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether non-shaqi can carry the reciprocal arrow of not burdening the mother rather than only describing his own condition.
Whether servant-status and shared lordship constrain jabbar or only resonate with it.
How far repair and dry-land branches may color prose without being mistaken for lexical substitutions.
